title: Tangent measures of self-similar sets satisfying the strong separation condition
summary: This paper investigates tangent measures in the sense of Preiss for self-similar sets on ${\mathbb{R}^d}$ that satisfy the strong separation condition. Through the dynamics of ``zooming in'' on any typical point, we derive an explicit and uniform formula for the tangent measures associated with this category of self-similar sets on ${\mathbb{R}^d}$.
